assumption_to_test: A compact policy-lineage and replay model can deterministically classify changed outcomes without implementing cryptography.
smallest_testable_validation: Add one superseding policy revision and replay the v0.8.4 decision against frozen attestation inputs; retain negative fixtures for lineage, mutation, missing input, and governance.
expected_learning: Whether policy change, evidence change, and time change can remain separate and reproducible.
expected_cost: One qif-ledger schema slice, verifier rules, examples, fixtures, documentation, and release.
success_threshold: All declared lineage and replay outputs reproduce; original decision is unchanged; negative fixtures fail; full npm test passes.
